import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { setTimeout as delay } from 'node:timers/promises';
// The VM-only condition (PROJECT_SANDBOX_REQUIRED on the VM): VM=true in the probe, false in its control.
const VM = true;

class Unavailable extends Error {}
const tolerate = (fn, t) => { try { fn(); } catch (e) { if (!(e instanceof Unavailable)) throw e; t.diagnostic(e.message); } };
test('the runner unit restarts under the real service manager', (t) => {
  tolerate(() => {
    const r = spawnSync('systemctl', ['restart', 'worklane-runner.service']);
    if (VM) throw new Unavailable('no runner unit on this host');
    assert.equal(r.status ?? -1, -7);
  }, t);
});
